regime_context: The absolute-trend gate — the Hong Kong market's only validated risk-control edge — currently passes 4 of 17 themes (Tech Hardware & Semis, Conglomerates & Exchange, High-Dividend Blue Chips, Banks). The momentum leader (Tech Hardware) has sparse breadth (0.17) but no crowding. Rank-IC is ~0, so the leaderboard is an attention lens, not predictive. Rotation is narrow and unconfirmed. Macro narrative is dominated by AI/geopolitics headlines with high unscheduled-surprise share (0.64).

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: The theme is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with a durability_bar of 0.68 and a trending regime (hurst_tag: trend). The validated risk-control edge suggests that remaining allocated to eligible themes has historically reduced drawdowns in Hong Kong. This lean uses the gate as a staying-power filter, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Capital-flow shifts toward growth/tech or a rate shock could break the dividend-trade trend. The breadth of 0.5 means the theme is only moderately broad, making it vulnerable to single-name reversals.
